subject: [RFC PATCH 4/5] mm/page_alloc: skip movable blocks during non-movable steals

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the __rmqueue_steal function in the Linux kernel's page allocation module to prevent non-movable allocations from stealing pages from movable blocks. This is done by adding a check that ensures non-movable allocations do not steal from movable blocks, which could lead to fragmentation and break compaction. The patch aims to reduce direct reclaim and compaction stalls, improving system performance.
